body: The operator confirms backlog-implementer-v3 acknowledged instructions and owns the SOLE fix-day implementation lane; earlier implementation sessions are superseded. This is a checkpoint-evidence request on that existing assignment, not new work. Please report actual native session ID, owned scope/lease, worktree/branch, base SHA, FULL checkpoint SHA, completed fix-day items, exact commands/results/log artifacts, blockers and next action. If no ready checkpoint exists, report that without inventing a SHA. Coordination will prepare backlog-regression and backlog-verifier-1 handoffs against the reported SHA, with one final whole-branch code review. Registry repair is not required; do not restart sessions or prune ambiguous leases for this request.
subject: Sole-owner v3 checkpoint evidence request
